name: x2611_15379_thmA
original:
For every $k\in\mathbb{N}$ , the least positive period $P_{k}$ of $g_{k}$ is given by

 $P_{k}=\prod\limits_{\begin{subarray}{c}p\text{ prime }\\
p\leq k\end{subarray}}p^{\delta_{p}(k)},$ 

where

 $\delta_{p}(k)=\begin{cases}0,&v_{p}(k+1)\geq\max\limits_{1\leq i\leq k}v_{p}(i),\\
\max\limits_{1\leq i\leq k}v_{p}(i),&\text{ otherwise }.\end{cases}$
type: ∀ (k : ℕ), IsLeast {T | 0 < T ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → Mathlib2.x2611_15379_G k 1 0 1 (fun n => ↑n) (n + T) = Mathlib2.x2611_15379_G k 1 0 1 (fun n => ↑n) n} (Mathlib2.x2611_15379_monotonicPeriod k 1 0 1)
